migration.title: Migrate / resize slot
migration.description: Keeps the original disk and account data; pauses scheduling and drains requests, migrates while powered off, then verifies the service. This is not a live migration.
migration.scopeHelp: Only running remote Linux Claude KVM slots (not crag) and memory enlargement are supported. Both nodes must have identical images; direct or loopback egress across nodes is rejected. Jobs run serially with rate-limited disk transfer and may take tens of minutes. The cold disk on the original node is kept for rollback and is not deleted automatically.
migration.confirm: I accept a brief outage; if preflight fails, the original slot is not stopped.
migration.closeHint: Closing this window does not cancel the job; reopen it to check progress.
migration.kvmOnly: This version only supports remote Linux KVM slots

migration.phase.copying: Copying and verifying the sparse disk with rate limiting
migration.phase.cleanup: Cleaning up old runtime resources, keeping the cold disk
migration.phase.rolledBack: Migration failed; rolled back to the original node
